source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseCanvas001DeterministicTest { @isTest static void canvasObjectsAndConstants() { Canvas.ApplicationContext application = new Canvas.ApplicationContext(); Canvas.EnvironmentContext environment = new Canvas.EnvironmentContext(); Canvas.RenderContext render = new Canvas.RenderContext(); Canvas.CanvasLifecycleHandler handler = new Canvas.CanvasLifecycleHandler(); Canvas.CanvasRenderException empty = new Canvas.CanvasRenderException(); QueryException cause = new QueryException('cause'); Canvas.CanvasRenderException fromCause = new Canvas.CanvasRenderException(cause); Canvas.CanvasRenderException fromMessage = new Canvas.CanvasRenderException('message'); Canvas.CanvasRenderException fromBoth = new Canvas.CanvasRenderException('message', cause); System.assertNotEquals(null, application); System.assertNotEquals(null, environment); System.assertNotEquals(null, render); System.assertNotEquals(null, handler); System.assertNotEquals(null, empty.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, fromCause.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, fromMessage.clone()); System.assertNotEquals(null, fromBoth.clone()); Canvas.ContextTypeEnum organization = Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.ORGANIZATION; Canvas.ContextTypeEnum recordDetail = Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.RECORD_DETAIL; Canvas.ContextTypeEnum user = Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.USER; System.assertNotEquals(null, organization); System.assertNotEquals(null, recordDetail); System.assertEquals(true, user.equals(Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.USER)); System.assertEquals(false, user.equals(Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.ORGANIZATION)); System.assertEquals(false, user.equals(null)); Integer userHash = user.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, userHash); System.assertEquals(userHash, user.hashCode()); System.assertEquals(2, user.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(true, Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.valueOf('USER').equals(user)); List<Canvas.ContextTypeEnum> contextTypes = Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.values(); System.assertEquals(3, contextTypes.size()); System.assertEquals(Canvas.ContextTypeEnum.USER, contextTypes[2]); Object canvasUrl = Canvas.Test.KEY_CANVAS_URL; Object developerName = Canvas.Test.KEY_DEVELOPER_NAME; Object displayLocation = Canvas.Test.KEY_DISPLAY_LOCATION; Object locationUrl = Canvas.Test.KEY_LOCATION_URL; Object name = Canvas.Test.KEY_NAME; Object namespaceName = Canvas.Test.KEY_NAMESPACE; Object subLocation = Canvas.Test.KEY_SUB_LOCATION; Object version = Canvas.Test.KEY_VERSION; System.assertNotEquals(null, canvasUrl); System.assertNotEquals(null, developerName); System.assertNotEquals(null, displayLocation); System.assertNotEquals(null, locationUrl); System.assertNotEquals(null, name); System.assertNotEquals(null, namespaceName); System.assertNotEquals(null, subLocation); System.assertNotEquals(null, version); } }
